notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Slip On the Ring.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
